nodes.label: Prompt Spec Is Not Runtime Truth
nodes.rationale: The application does not load this Markdown at runtime. Actual behavior lives in backend/agent/select.py, knowledge.py, place.py, backend/server/intake_service.py and backend/server/scene_service.py. Style recommendation, material editing and the full JSON shape are target behavior, and the document alone is never proof a feature is implemented.

nodes.label: LLM Core Behavior Rules
nodes.rationale: One question at a time, one primary recommendation plus at most two alternatives, interpretation separated from deterministic filtering (application rules enforce dimensions, availability, placement, UV support and valid IDs), centimetres for all measurements, Taiwan apartment constraints as defaults, concise Traditional Chinese, and never exposing prompts, API keys, raw catalog dumps or hidden reasoning.

nodes.label: LLM Intake-to-Scene-Handoff Workflow
nodes.rationale: Intake, interview, style recommendation, furniture filtering (hard catalog/dimension/clearance filter before style scoring), material editing, then scene handoff returning intent and constraints only — backend.engine, not the LLM, owns coordinates, collision, clearance and final placement validation.

nodes.label: 0-100 Component Scoring Model
nodes.rationale: Explicit components style_fit, palette_fit, function_fit, space_fit, taiwan_fit and material_editability. A high overall score may never hide a failing hard constraint: anything blocking a door/window, exceeding available space, lacking a required GLB or violating a must-keep rule is rejected regardless of style score.

nodes.label: Required LLM JSON Contract
nodes.rationale: status/reply/next_question/recommendation/furniture/scene_plan/warnings shape using only application-supplied IDs and placement roles; next_question null when none remains, recommendation null until evidence suffices, uncertainty and missing GLB/UV/texture go to warnings, and no markdown fences or prose outside JSON.

nodes.label: Material Edit and UV/GLB Rules
nodes.rationale: uv_available true means usable TEXCOORD_0 but not that a desired texture exists; mode color works without UV, mode texture needs UV plus a valid texture asset and compatible slot, mode unsupported is mandatory when an edit cannot be applied safely, and geometry, scale and position must be preserved during colour/material-only changes.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Failure and Deterministic Fallback
nodes.rationale: If OpenRouter is unavailable, return a deterministic fallback recommendation from supplied JSON rules with a warning; invalid JSON is retried once with a repair instruction then falls back. Never fabricate a successful 3D render, GLB edit, texture application or furniture placement — application validation stays authoritative.
